content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing difficulties using [product_name] programming software on my laptop with a 4k touch screen. The interface appears extremely distorted and is challenging to work with, as shown in my attached screenshot. Changing display settings has not helped. Computer Model: ASUS N552VW Windows 10 Pro [product_name] V[version_no] It seems like this issue is inherent to the software, since all other programs (including other [company_name] applications) work fine on my system. Has anyone else encountered problems running [product_name] on a 4k display?
Check if the following resources assist you: [url] and [url] for potential solutions to scaling issues with high-DPI (4k) screens.

Locate the [product_name] .exe file you installed. Right click, go to Properties, open the Compatibility tab, enable 'Override high DPI scaling behavior', and select 'System' for 'Scaling performed by:'. This resolved the issue for me.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing major usability challenges with [product_name] when running the software on laptops with 4k touch screens due to improper scaling, which causes a distorted interface. This problem is specific to [company_name] software, as other applications from the same vendor operate correctly. The conversations show that scaling issues on high-resolution displays are a common concern.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to offer full compatibility with high-DPI and 4k screens, with an interface as clear and functional as other [company_name] software.
